title: Wind-Tunnel Data Reduction Software — Overview and definition
t: Wind-Tunnel Data Reduction Software — Overview and definition
description: Reduces raw tunnel measurements to corrected aerodynamic coefficients.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Reduces raw tunnel measurements to corrected aerodynamic coefficients. Wind-tunnel data reduction software applies tare, blockage, wall-interference, and sting corrections to balance and pressure data, producing publication-quality polars. Real implementations are facility-specific (NASA, DNW) plus open post-processing scripts. It propagates measurement uncertainty into every coefficient. Engineering research use only. Capability specification and design target: this database describes what the tool must do, not a claim of implementation or deployment.
